/-- **The residue-field comparison at a point of an affine test, as an algebra map.**

`Over.testPointField t` is the *scheme* residue field `(Spec A).residueField t`, while every
engine-facing predicate reads the *algebraic* residue field `t.asIdeal.ResidueField` of the
prime.  Mathlib's `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them; this records the identification in
the form the tower needs, namely that the canonical `A`-algebra structure on the scheme
residue field (`Over.instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine`) factors through the algebraic one.

Proof: both sides are `Spec.preimage` of a morphism out of `Spec κ(t)`, and `Spec.map` is
injective on homs, so it suffices to compare after applying `Spec.map` — where the identity is
mathlib's `Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField`. -/
lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine_factors {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
    algebraMap A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
      = ((Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv).hom.comp
          (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
  rw [Over.algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine]
  have h : Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)
      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (t : PrimeSpectrum A).asIdeal.ResidueField)
          ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of A) t).inv := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [Spec.map_preimage, Spec.map_comp]
    exact (Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField (.of A) t).symm
  rw [h]
  rfl

/-- **The witness predicate at a scheme-residue field agrees with the one at the prime's
residue field, and the resulting locus is open.**

`Over.testPointField t` is `(Spec A).residueField t` and the engine reads
`t.asIdeal.ResidueField`; `Spec.residueFieldIso` identifies them, and the witness predicate
transfers along any field extension in the `A`-tower
(`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`, `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:142`), in
particular along an isomorphism.

* the **carrier identification** `↥(overSpec k A).left = PrimeSpectrum A` is *definitional*

## Mode (a) sharpened — the census that finds direct carriers does not find this (from `I-0530`)

The standing "grep the build log for `declaration uses sorry`, check which carriers are `instance`" census counts an instance only if its **body** contains `sorry` directly. `instHasPicSchemeEt` (`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`) has body `(fgaPicardRepresentability C).1`, an open obligation, and emits **no warning at all**.

Measured consequence: `Pic0SchemeEt` was declared *without* a `[HasPicSchemeEt C]` binder, the instance fired at elaboration, and `sorryAx` was baked into the **definition** — so every theorem about the object leaked however clean its own argument was, while `PicSchemeEt` one level up (which does take the binder) stayed clean. Four docstrings claiming "PROVED unconditionally" were wrong.

- **The check:** run `#print axioms` on the **definition**, not only on theorems about it, and compare with the same declaration carrying the gate as an explicit binder. Clean-with-binder plus dirty-without is the signature.
- **The rule:** when a gate class has an unconditional instance whose body is an open obligation, every definition downstream should take the gate as a **binder**. Parametricity is lost silently at the first declaration that omits it.
- Do not quote "zero sorry-bodied instances" as "no synthesis leak".

## New mode (i) — DE-INSTANCING FIXES THE LEAK, AND CAN MAKE THE PROBE GO VACUOUSLY CLEAN (from `I-0526`)

Two halves, both measured closing the flat-pullback exactness leak in AJC (run 0068, `ajc-fbc`, commits `df899aa50`, `519eecb15`):

1. **The `instance` attribute is the mechanism, not the `sorry`.** As an instance, `pullback_preservesFiniteLimits` was reachable by synthesis anywhere in scope, so `theorem q {g} [Flat g] : PreservesFiniteLimits (pullback g) := inferInstance` elaborated and reported `sorryAx`. Changing `instance` to `theorem` makes that same `inferInstance` **fail**, forcing consumers to name the carrier so the dependency appears in the proof term. Cost: zero (`lake build` stayed green at 8762 jobs). Do it the moment a sorried instance is introduced.
2. **The probe may then start measuring something else.** `leakProbe_pullback_finiteLimits` was built on the **identity** morphism (because `Flat (𝟙 S)` synthesises for free). After de-instancing it went from `sorryAx` to clean — not because anything was proved, but because for the identity the pullback *is* the identity functor (`Scheme.Modules.pullbackId`) and synthesis found a cheaper clean route. A session reading the diff would have reported a closure that did not happen.

**Defences, both now in `scripts/axiom-frontier.lean`:** probe over a GENERAL argument and NAME the carrier rather than synthesising it; and always ship a CONTROL that must come out the other way. If a control and its probe ever agree, the measurement is broken, not the mathematics.

## Companion to mode (d) — A GATE CLASS THAT ONLY ASSERTS INHABITATION (from `I-0536`)

Mode (d) is a binder **nothing** can instantiate. Its dual is a binder **anything** can instantiate, and it reads identically in the axiom line. `PicScheme.ClassDegree` is exactly `Nonempty (relPicClasses →+ ℤ)`; that type contains `0`, so `⟨⟨0⟩⟩` proves it with no hypothesis, and the total function built on it (`degreeOfSection`) is not pinned to the degree. The "one remaining input" demanded nothing.

- Fine: `HasPicScheme` = `∃ X, RepresentableBy X ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType ∧ IsSeparated` (a PROPERTY of the object).
- Vacuous: `Nonempty (A →+ B)`, `Nonempty (A → ℤ)`, `Nonempty (A ≃ B)` whenever `B` has a point.
- **The probe:** restate the class as a `theorem` with no gate and try `⟨⟨0⟩⟩` / `⟨default⟩` / `⟨fun _ => 0⟩`. It is live as issue `I-0534`.' 2>&1 | tail -3
